meta.title: HOI AN 🇻🇳 Vegan Cooking Class | Part 2
meta.description:
✨In part two of our Hoi An series, we’re diving into a vegan cooking class to create delicious dishes with the fresh ingredients we gathered at the market in part one! 

🌱This unique experience, booked through Get Your Guide, brings us face-to-face with local flavors and techniques. From colorful herbs to flavorful spices, this cooking class showcases the essence of Vietnamese cuisine, all vegan-friendly! Join me as we cook, learn, and savor Hoi An’s culinary magic.

🎟️If you're interested in availing this activity, check out the link here: 
https://www.getyourguide.com/hoi-an-l831/hoi-an-vegan-cooking-school-with-local-chef-and-basket-boat-t585158/

Don't forget to like, subscribe, and hit that notification bell for more exciting travel vlogs to come!
